title: Stock tips group turns into a 'SEBI' arrest threat

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Sir, you joined our share market tips group last month. I am calling about your trading account.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Actually I must inform you, SEBI has flagged the group for illegal trading and I am now connecting you to the SEBI vigilance officer.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Mr. Gupta, this is SEBI vigilance. Your PAN is linked to insider trading worth 2 crore. The police will arrest you today.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Then pay the settlement penalty of 1,20,000 rupees within one hour and the case is closed. Tell no one, this is a sealed proceeding.
